concerns.text: The plan cites a FAISS index sourced from `https://huggingface.co/datasets/AlgorithmicResearchGroup/arxiv_abstracts_specter_faiss_flat_index/resolve/main/arxiv-abstracts.jsonl`, which contains arXiv abstract embeddings. This dataset is unrelated to the Ego4D video‑MAE embeddings used for memory nodes, making the baseline retrieval incomparable and invalid for the research question. Replace the FAISS index with one built from the Ego4D embeddings (or another egocentric video embedding index) to ensure modality and domain consistency.
